credits.title: Ebenezer
credits.overview: An elderly miser named Sonny O’dell embarks on a supernatural journey across Jaywick after visits from the ghost of his former business partner Sani and the Spirits of Primetime Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

credits.title: Joey Essex vs. Dapper Laughs
credits.overview: Joey Essex returns to the ring as he faces comedian Dapper Laughs.

credits.title: Jordan McCann vs. Big Stacks
credits.overview: Misfits Boxing brings fireworks to Newcastle, as an explosive grudge-match between Jordan McCann and Big Stacks headlines a huge bill of crossover fights on DAZN.
